seoTitle: Column Grid Planner: Gutters, Margins, Column Widths and CSS
metaDescription: Enter canvas width, columns, gutter and margin to get exact column widths and positions, CSS grid code and an SVG overlay. Free, local.
intro: Calculates the width and left edge of every column in a design grid and writes the matching CSS grid and an SVG overlay.
why:
Design files and code need the same numbers. The tool applies column = (canvas - 2 x margin - gutter x (columns - 1)) / columns, lists each column start, shows the width of a four column span and gives CSS that reproduces the grid with fractional units.

It rejects settings where columns would have no width. The overlay preview is an SVG you can paste into a design tool.
howTo: Enter canvas width, number of columns, gutter and margin.
Read the column width and positions.
Copy the CSS grid or the SVG overlay.

faq.q: Is this the same as CSS Grid Generator?
faq.a: That tool builds CSS grids interactively. This one starts from design numbers and gives exact pixel positions.
Many grids do not divide evenly. Design tools round them, CSS keeps them exact.
Use the 1fr columns in the CSS, which adapt to the width.
